name: factorio-serf
title: Serf
author: Stephen Kirby
description: An AI teammate ("serf") that plays as a real character next to you: walks, mines, crafts and builds under normal player rules, and takes orders from chat. Type /serf add. It runs on your own computer with your own Claude login (the serf app); servers can also host serfs over RCON. github.com/stirby/factorio-serf
